prompts.turf-v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating terrain material for a top-down 2D rendered-miniature game, Solace. Create a square full-bleed ground texture, a close overhead view of beautiful soft mossy highland turf. Fine short blue-green grass blades intermixed with velvety moss, subtle muted olive-green variations, occasional tiny dry stems and soil specks. Gentle overcast light, rich miniature hand-painted realism, grounded and mysterious. Mostly smooth coherent living carpet, detail visible but quiet enough for dense small sprites to sit on it. Colors mid-value desaturated forest/sage green with subtle teal shadows, not brown. Uniform scale and brightness edge to edge. Seamless wrap in both directions. No obvious mottled large spots, no clusters of rocks, no flowers, no trees, no scenery, no grid, no tiles, no vignette, no gradients towards edges, no text. Entire image is only the material, no perspective.
prompts.river-v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeating river surface material for overhead 2D rendered-miniature game Solace. Square full-bleed close overhead water texture: beautiful clear deep blue-green river water, softly layered translucent currents, delicate irregular elongated silver-teal reflection streaks and subtle ripples, gently flowing downward. Rich painterly miniature material with soft overcast sky reflections. Mostly calm dark jade/teal water, restrained pale highlights occupying less than ten percent, occasional soft subsurface tones, coherent depth. Small detail, not a uniform flat blue slab. Seamless on all edges. No shoreline, rocks, objects, foam blobs, dramatic waves, horizon, sky, scene, grid, square cells, text or vignette. Only water material filling every pixel, overhead view.
prompts.earth-v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless repeatable worn footpath material for a miniature settlement game. Square overhead full-bleed fine compacted warm gray-brown earth, crushed mineral dust, subtle small embedded rounded pebbles and faint irregular worn tracks. Grounded hand-painted miniature realism matching soft mossy highlands and timber huts. Quiet low contrast earthy taupe, tiny granular texture with soft daylight, no large rocks and no bright gravel. Uniform material edge to edge, seamless repeating all directions. No grass, plants, road edges, perspective, grid, symbols, tire tracks, objects, scene, vignette or text. This is only the surface material; engine supplies the irregular path outline.
prompts.crossings-v2: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent modular bridge sprite atlas for Solace rendered miniature tile game. A STRICT 3-column by 4-row atlas, twelve separate equally sized square cells, neat aligned grid, transparent background, no labels. Each bridge module fills the width of its cell and has the SAME joining profile as its neighboring module so modules connect into a long bridge without stretching. Row1 horizontal weathered timber bridge: left bank entrance with two low stone footings; repeating central deck with crosswise wooden planks and very low rope/beam side rails; right bank entrance with two low stone footings. Row2 horizontal old gray mossy stone bridge: left bank cap; repeatable center with irregular flagstone deck and low stone side edges; right bank cap. Row3 vertical timber bridge: north entrance; repeating center; south entrance. Row4 vertical stone bridge: north entrance; repeating center; south entrance. Orthogonal directions, all twelve use nearly overhead camera, slight front edge thickness, soft light consistently from upper left. Beautiful grounded miniature rendering: rich worn timber grain, sculpted rough mossy stones, restrained moss along outer edges. Walkable deck clearly readable. Central pieces have NO end posts, end walls or entrance. Horizontal pieces meet exactly left and right; vertical pieces meet exactly top and bottom. No river, ground bases, terrain squares, scenery, shadows outside bridge silhouette, perspective diagonal, text or watermarks. Transparent between separate cells, same scale across all pieces.
